selection.ownership: BigML, Inc., a Delaware corporation with offices at 2851 NW 9th Street, Suite D, Corvallis, Oregon 97330, United States (European office in Valencia, Spain). The reviewed edition is the public international API at https://bigml.io/andromeda, not a mainland-China product and not a private/VPC BigML deployment.

research.searchCoverage: Official BigML.io Andromeda API (username and api_key query parameters, GET /model, GET /model/{id}, GET /prediction, GET /prediction/{id}), credential help, Corvallis/US identity, private-deployment note distinguished from the public host, and dated incident search for BigML security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved BigML customer-account compromise identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official public API at https://bigml.io/andromeda with username and api_key query authentication, GET /model?limit=1 as the cheap authenticated model list used by the pinned credential validator (not a billed prediction), model and prediction list/get reads, Corvallis identity, and dated 2026-09-13 incident search. Private/VPC API servers are not exposed. Create/delete prediction writes are omitted. No current unresolved customer-account compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /model?limit=1 used by the pinned credential validator. This lists existing models and is not a billed prediction create. Native sends username via shared query and api_key via query auth. Native omits the upstream User-Agent. Native category is dev-tools rather than AI/Data. Private BigML deployments are not admitted.
Official GET /model with optional limit, offset, order_by, project, and name__icontains. Input names follow pinned runtime (orderBy, nameContains).
Official GET /model/{id}. modelId is the bare resource id in /model/{id}; native does not auto-prefix model/ as the pinned runtime does. Optional fieldLimit/fieldOffset map to limit/offset.
Official GET /prediction with the same list filters as models. Create prediction is omitted because it is a billed write.
Official GET /prediction/{id}. predictionId is the bare resource id. Delete prediction is omitted.
